governance.attested_by: pjm-121 CC_LIKE mid-curve belt (scored 2026-07-25; bundle re-solved byte-faithfully 2026-07-26 by pjm-122 after the original container was archived — meta.timestamp is pinned to the scored run's date so the dashboard id 2026-07-25-pjm-121-cc-belt is preserved; the re-solve reproduces the scored run exactly, see residuals_note). EXACTLY ONE config delta vs the pjm-119 keeper, applied through replay_keeper --set: pjm_offer_midcurve_segments ('LONG_RUN',) -> ('LONG_RUN','CC_LIKE'). This hands the CC_REGULAR econ tranches to the ALREADY-FROZEN measured mid-curve offer surface (data/raw/_validation-source/pjm_offer_midcurve_condbinned.json — 36 months of PJM DataMiner2 energy_market_offers, 25.95M unit-hours / 3,595 units, within-unit capacity-share ladders keyed by within-year net-load percentile) at the same P1-only mc_bid_adjust seam, same floor-only (raise-only) semantics and same VOLL cap as the LONG_RUN scope live in the keeper line since pjm-104. Zero new free parameters: no offer-curve band, sigmoid, floor, ORDC parameter, derive value or surface JSON was touched (rules 13/20/21/23); the delta is a rule-19 SCOPE flag, satisfied by replacement — the floor is a max() against the fitted band on the CC econ rows, and the CC peak rungs stay fitted-curve-owned. Measured OFFERS are the input; clearing prices stay validation-only (rule 13). Full write-up: docs/FINDING-pjm121-ccbelt-c3a-close-2026-07.md.
governance.note: Solved as the rule-12 per-year chain (2023, then 2024, then 2025; one fresh process each, ~15 min/year, peak ~14.8 GB) into ONE bundle (rule 16, all scorable years); the chain's overwritten bundle-level aggregates (meta.years, system.parquet, btm.parquet) restored from the per-year hourly/ sidecars by scripts/probes/pjm119_merge_year_chain.py without re-solving. Benchmark rebuilt across all three years (--rebuild-benchmark). Mechanism engagement per year (solve logs): 410 (2023) / 444 (2024) / 461 (2025) priced tranche rows, tightest net-load bin 263/8760 h in every year — the FINDING doc's '264 -> 461' is the 2025 pair. Also built this session and REFUTED WITHOUT A SOLVE: the LEVEL-form measured ladder (ScenarioConfig.pjm_offer_midcurve_level_segments, default-off, six regression tests in tests/test_pjm_offer_midcurve_level_form.py). The pre-registered kill criterion in scripts/probes/pjm121_level_form_precheck.py fired: level CC_LIKE LOWERS the CC econ bids -8.76 $/MWh MW-weighted (87.5% of row-hours cheaper) and NARROWS the offer spread in every net-load bin, where the floor form widens all four — a level-lowering lever cannot close a dispersion gap. Kept in the codebase default-off as the correct construction for a fleet whose fitted bands sit BELOW measured.
governance.residuals_note: RESULT vs the pjm-119 keeper: C3a mean LMP FAIL -> PASS, everything else unchanged (C1 16/16, free 12/12; C2/C3b/C3c/C4/C5a/C7/C8 PASS) — CALIBRATED, 10/10, PJM's first all-pass determination. C3a (RT load-weighted): 2023 +5.6% (keeper +4.7), 2024 -2.5% (keeper -3.8), 2025 -9.3% (keeper -10.7 FAIL; band +/-10%): 2025 model $41.53 vs actual $45.80. Re-solve fidelity (pjm-122): the 2025 stratum readout reproduces the scored run TO THE CENT — model_lw 41.53 / actual_lw 46.07 / gap -4.54, stratum contributions +2.015 / +2.249 / -3.662 / -2.487 / -1.126 / -1.534. HONEST SCOPE (rule 1): of the +$0.35/MWh 2025 gain, +$0.254 (73%) comes from the two CHEAP strata the model already over-priced (0-25 +1.965 -> +2.015, 25-50 +2.045 -> +2.249) and only +$0.087 from the four tight strata — the pjm-120 monotone dispersion compression is essentially untouched. The gate closes on a legitimate MEASURED mechanism, not a fitted adder, but this is a LEVEL effect and must never be reported as the dispersion repair. The open root cause stays where pjm-120 put it: reserve/LP supply-side tightness (G-20b / ERCOT-G-22 class — 38.1 GW deliverable 10-min ramp vs a ~3.7 GW requirement; the reserve dual reaches $300 in zero hours). New probe scripts/probes/pjm121_marginal_decomp.py: COAL sets 38-80% of the price in EVERY actual-price stratum and CC_REGULAR is essentially never marginal (0-1%) despite 33-50 GW dispatched. No lever was tuned to any residual in this run (rules 1/11/13).
